# Stage 3c corpus phrase list (plans/speech-rules/plan.md, "Stage 3c -- state-dependent
# speech-to-text hint", step 3). Read by tools/record_corpus.py --phrases-file.
#
# Lines starting with # are comments (including this block) and blank lines are skipped.
# Record each phrase at its default --takes repetitions. The four phrases under "Refusal
# cases" must be said while NOT in the matching state, exactly as plan.md specifies --
# record_corpus.py has no way to enforce or prompt for aircraft state, so follow the
# per-line note yourself:
#   - "turn left thirty" / "turn left 30" -- say these while NOT flying (parked AI-overlay
#     off, or not in the pilot's seat with controls) -- expect "unable, not flying" once
#     Stage 4's gate is exercised live.
#   - "watch nearest" / "binoculars" -- say these WHILE flying -- expect "unable, hands
#     busy" once Stage 6 ports that reason (recorded now so the corpus does not need a
#     second session later; this will not yet produce that refusal live).

# Number words and digit forms
turn left thirty
turn left 30
turn left three zero

# Heading / level / straight-synonym forms
heading three one five
level flight
straight
level off

# Speed forms
speed two hundred
speed max
speed one hundred fifty three
speed two two zero

# Altitude forms
altitude three hundred
altitude three zero zero barometric
climb fifty
descend one hundred

# Hold altitude
hold altitude

# HVRT bare words
left
right
forward
back
hold
up
down

# Refusal cases -- record these while NOT in the matching state (see header note)
turn left thirty
turn left 30
watch nearest
binoculars

# Non-command sentences, for contrast (real entries from vocabulary.FREE_SPEECH_GUARD,
# not invented -- checked against src/vocabulary.py directly)
look at that
the tanks are on the ridge
describe the mission to me
silence is golden
be careful
